final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT invoice_number AS inv, CAST(SUM(derived_product_cost) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM s1) SELECT s1.inv, s1.ratio, s1.cnt, s1.ratio / NULLIF(s2.avg_ratio, 0) AS rel FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rel DESC LIMIT 10
